_comment: Chapter heading patterns (Python regular expressions, matched against a trimmed line). 'default' is the built-in pattern; 'presets' fill the GUI drop-down.
default: ^\s*(?:제\s*\d+\s*(?:장|화|편|부|회|막)\b|\d{1,4}\s*(?:장|화|편|부|회)(?=\s|$)|\d{1,4}\s*\.(?:\s+\S|$)|(?:Chapter|CHAPTER|Part|PART)\s+(?:\d+|[IVXLC]+)\b|(?:Prologue|PROLOGUE|Epilogue|EPILOGUE)\b|第\s*[\d一二三四五六七八九十百千零〇]+\s*(?:章|話|话|回|節|节|部|卷|集)|프롤로그|에필로그|서장|종장|序章|終章|终章|プロローグ|エピローグ)
presets: ^\s*第\s*[\d一二三四五六七八九十百千零〇]+\s*[章话話回]
